messages:
maria: Quick check — vendor just dropped a provisional manifest for rack r-42 (H100 x8 / node). They also flagged that PDUs are dedicated but firmware is 1.2.3 and BIOS 4.0. Can we pick a smoke-test window next week? Thinking Wed 02 Apr 02:00-04:00 UTC. @aj @chris @lee please weigh in.

aj: I can confirm PDUs are reserved on that rack, had a quick sync with power team. They want a heads-up 48h before racking so they can stage breakers. Wed 02 Apr at 02:00 UTC is fine from infra side.

chris: We need a temporary quota bump in eu-west1 for the smoke runs (we'll spin up 4 test nodes). I'll open a quota request now — filing against cloud-ticket#4872 and tagging infra. Link: https://tickets.internal/4872 — please react with :thumbsup: if you want me to include any extra SKUs.

lee: Small ask — avoid the 02:00-03:00 UTC slot if possible; that's when analytics nightly jobs hit the EU cluster and we saw noisy neighbors last time. 03:30-05:30 UTC would be safer. If Wed is sticky for vendor, I can shift the nightly job window by 90m.

vendor-ops: Automated update: manifest received for r-42. Provisional ship ETA 2024-04-06 08:00 UTC. Rack serials and PDU assignments attached to the ticket. (vendor-ops-bot)

maria: Thanks @vendor-ops and @aj. I'll move the smoke test to Wed 02 Apr 03:30-05:30 UTC to avoid analytics load. @chris — please include GPUs and NIC bandwidth in the quota request (we need 10GbE per node for perf runs).

chris: Done — updated cloud-ticket#4872 with additional SKUs (gpu.h100-8, network.10gbe). Set requested window: 2024-04-01 to 2024-04-10 for an ephemeral bump.

oncall-bot: Reminder — any scheduled infra tests that affect production traffic require a runbook in #eng-oncall 24h before the test. See https://docs.internal/runbooks/smoke-tests

maria: Will post runbook in eng-oncall today. Draft steps include vendor racking verification, PDU sanity, boot logs, nvml GPU count check, and a tiny perf run. Quick manifest snippet for the test nodes: ```json
{
  "rack": "r-42",
  "nodes": [ { "id": "r42-n1", "gpus": 8 }, { "id": "r42-n2", "gpus": 8 } ]
}```

aj: For the nvml check use: `ssh ops@r42-n1 'python3 -c "import pynvml; pynvml.nvmlInit(); print(pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetCount())"'` — that should return 8 per node. Also make sure the BMC firmware is reachable before we power cycle.

sre-runner: I'll stand by to run the smoke harness. My checklist: 1) quota OK 2) vendor confirmation 3) PDUs staged 4) runbook in eng-oncall. Ping me in-thread 1h before.

maria: Perfect. I'll close out with vendor today, post the runbook, and ping @sre-runner and @aj 1h before the test. Thanks all :raised_hands:
